findings.title: Compact actions do not record usage on all execution paths
findings.description: The SDK-rotation path stamps usage only after a successful `compact()` call; its exception handler returns a failed result without the telemetry attached to provider errors. The prompt-only path also returns without recording usage on success: it calls `claude_agent_sdk.query()` directly and never reads result usage or stamps a record. Since `compact` is counted as an LLM action by `sq stats run`, spend from these calls is omitted.

findings.title: Split-review totals keep only the first part’s usage
findings.description: Each review part receives its own usage record, but `_metadata()` copies only the first part’s metadata when folding multiple parts. The persisted step therefore reports just the first part’s spend, undercounting tokens, turns, and cost for split pipeline reviews.

findings.title: Fan-out branch usage is discarded before persistence
findings.description: The executor passes the run’s usage capture into fan-out branches, but the `collect` reducer serializes branch action results without their metadata. The other reducers also return selected outputs without branch usage metadata. Consequently, the resulting `fan_out` action has no usage record, and `sq stats run` cannot include those branch calls in its totals.

findings.title: Earlier loop iterations are absent from run usage totals
findings.description: The report reads only persisted `completed_steps[*].action_results`. Earlier loop iterations are held in `StepResult.prior_rounds`, but `StateManager._append_step()` serializes only `action_results`. Thus, for loops that run more than once, the persisted state—and consequently this report—omits spend from earlier rounds.

findings.title: Malformed cost basis can abort the reviews report
findings.description: `_basis()` checks an unvalidated frontmatter value for membership in a set. If YAML parses `costBasis` as a list or mapping, that membership check raises `TypeError`; the report then aborts instead of warning and treating the malformed field as unreported, as it does for other invalid fields.
